content: { "rules": [ "Model forecasts are systematically too high during price declines, showing excessive lag that pushes prices below true bottoms", "Sentiment turning negative (0.00-0.33) causes model to undershoot true prices by 1-3 EUR, especially in downward phases", "When prices are consolidating within a 2-3 EUR range, model over-smooths and misses true price volatility", "Sentiment strength (0.67-1.00) correlates with model undershoots of 1-2 EUR, suggesting delayed sentiment incorporation", "Marked price divergence emerges when moving away from model's calculated mean, with true outcomes showing more volatility", "Negative sentiment combined with declining prices causes the largest forecast errors, with model missing lows by 2-4 EUR", "Model fails to capture price inflection points when sentiment is mixed, resulting in delayed and softened forecasts" ] }
